enthalpy-of-fusion.def: The energy absorbed to melt 1 mol of a solid at its melting point (ΔHfus; water 6.01 kJ/mol). Freezing releases the same amount.

enthalpy-of-vaporization.def: The energy absorbed to vaporize 1 mol of a liquid at its boiling point (ΔHvap; water 40.7 kJ/mol). Condensing releases the same amount.

heating-curve.def: A graph of temperature against energy added (or time); sloped parts show one phase warming (q = mcΔT), and flat parts show a phase change at constant temperature (q = nΔH).
